title: The Episode About the First Sikh Guni

blocks.text: The siddhs were dismayed that Baba Ji had eclipsed their renown, and they spoke among themselves in pride. (58)
Yet Baba Ji advanced to meet them under the Guru’s protection, and they could not withstand him. (59)
From Farid Pattan to Multan and Ucch, he entered into discourse with all and spared no effort in teaching. (60)
Thus across Punjab he won the trust of the people, establishing dharamsals and guiding each community toward truth. (61–62)
